cards.ex: I like to crack open a book on a rainy afternoon.
cards.exUz: Yomg'irli tushdan keyin kitob o'qishni boshlashni yoqtiraman.
cards.uzDef: Kitobni o'qishni boshlash, odatda dam olish uchun.

cards.ex: That new thriller is a real page-turner; I finished it in one night!
cards.exUz: Yangi triller haqiqiy qiziqarli kitob; uni bir kechada tugatdim!
cards.uzDef: Shunday qiziq kitobki, o'qishni to'xtata olmaysiz.

cards.ex: I'm trying to get through this really long novel.
cards.exUz: Men shu juda uzun romanni o'qib tugatishga harakat qilyapman.
cards.uzDef: Kitobni o'qib tugatmoq, ba'zan qiyinchilik bilan.

cards.ex: It's a well-written book, but the plot is a bit slow.
cards.exUz: Bu yaxshi yozilgan kitob, lekin syujet biroz sekin.
cards.uzDef: Yaxshi uslubda va qiziqarli qilib yozilgan.

cards.ex: This book is so good, I just can't put it down!
cards.exUz: Bu kitob shunchalik yaxshiki, uni qo'yolmaysan!
cards.uzDef: Shunchalik qiziqki, kitobni o'qishni to'xtata olmaysiz.

cards.ex: His book on philosophy is pretty heavy reading.
cards.exUz: Uning falsafa haqidagi kitobi ancha og'ir o'qish.
cards.uzDef: Tushunish qiyin bo'lgan yoki ko'p fikrlashni talab qiladigan kitob.

cards.ex: I prefer light reading when I'm on vacation.
cards.exUz: Men ta'tilda bo'lganimda yengil o'qishni afzal ko'raman.
cards.uzDef: Oson va qiziqarli bo'lgan o'qish, dam olish uchun.

cards.ex: The movie is based on a true story.
cards.exUz: Film haqiqiy voqeaga asoslangan.
cards.uzDef: Biron bir narsa haqiqiy voqea yoki shaxsga asoslangan.

cards.ex: This novel is a must-read for anyone interested in history.
cards.exUz: Bu roman tarixga qiziquvchilar uchun o'qilishi shart bo'lgan kitob.
cards.uzDef: Hammaga tavsiya etiladigan, o'qilishi shart bo'lgan kitob.

cards.ex: She's such a bookworm; she always has a book with her.
cards.exUz: U shunday kitob qurti; u doim o'zi bilan kitob olib yuradi.
cards.uzDef: Kitoblarni juda sevuvchi va ko'p o'qiydigan odam.

cards.ex: I just flicked through the magazine while waiting.
cards.exUz: Men kutayotganimda jurnalni tezda ko'zdan kechirdim.
cards.uzDef: Kitobni tezda varaqlab, asosiy nuqtalarni ko'rib chiqmoq.

cards.ex: You have to read between the lines to understand what she really means.
cards.exUz: Uning aslida nimani nazarda tutayotganini tushunish uchun tagini o'qishingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Aytilmagan narsalarni tushunishga harakat qilish, yashirin ma'noni anglash.

cards.ex: You should take his review with a grain of salt; he's always biased.
cards.exUz: Uning sharhini shubha bilan qabul qilishingiz kerak; u doim xolis emas.
cards.term: take with a grain of salt
cards.uzDef: To'liq ishonmaslik, shubha bilan qabul qilish.

cards.ex: I only had time to skim through the report before the meeting.
cards.exUz: Yig'ilishdan oldin hisobotni yuzaki o'qishga vaqtim bor edi.
cards.uzDef: Matnni diqqat bilan o'qimasdan tezda ko'rib chiqmoq.

cards.ex: She devoured the whole series in just a week.
cards.exUz: U butun seriyani bir hafta ichida o'qib tugatdi.
cards.uzDef: Kitobni juda tez va zavq bilan o'qimoq.

cards.ex: I have a dog-eared copy of my favorite novel.
cards.exUz: Mening sevimli romanining burchaklari qayrilgan nusxasi bor.
cards.uzDef: Kitobning burchaklari qayrilgan, ko'p ishlatilgan.

cards.ex: The plot thickens as they discover more secrets.
cards.exUz: Ular ko'proq sirlarni kashf etgan sayin syujet murakkablashadi.
cards.uzDef: Voqealar yanada qiziqarli va murakkab bo'lib bormoqda.

cards.ex: The episode ended on a cliffhanger, so I can't wait for next week.
cards.exUz: Epizod keskin tugallanmagan sahna bilan yakunlandi, shuning uchun keyingi haftani kutaman.
cards.uzDef: Voqea oxirida qoldirilgan, keskin tugallanmagan sahna.

cards.ex: Moving to a new city was a new chapter in her life.
cards.exUz: Yangi shaharga ko'chish uning hayotidagi yangi bob edi.
cards.uzDef: Hayotdagi muhim davr yoki voqea.

cards.ex: In a nutshell, the book is about love and loss.
cards.exUz: Qisqacha aytganda, kitob sevgi va yo'qotish haqida.
cards.uzDef: Qisqacha va aniq qilib aytganda.

cards.ex: I need to hit the books; I have a big exam next week.
cards.exUz: Men qattiq o'qishim kerak; keyingi hafta katta imtihonim bor.
cards.uzDef: O'qishga qattiq kirishmoq, ko'p o'qimoq.

cards.ex: It's important that we're all on the same page before we start the project.
cards.exUz: Loyihani boshlashdan oldin hammamiz bir xil fikrda bo'lishimiz muhim.
cards.uzDef: Bir xil fikrda bo'lish, bir narsani bir xilda tushunish.

cards.ex: His speech was long-winded and boring.
cards.exUz: Uning nutqi uzoq so'zli va zerikarli edi.
cards.uzDef: Keragidan ortiqcha uzun va zerikarli gapiradigan/yozadigan.

cards.ex: She hired a ghostwriter to help her write her autobiography.
cards.exUz: U o'z tarjimai holini yozishda yordam berish uchun adabiy kotib yolladi.
cards.uzDef: Boshqa birov uchun kitob yozadigan odam (nomi ko'rsatilmaydi).

cards.ex: I prefer to read a hard copy of the book rather than an e-book.
cards.exUz: Men kitobning elektron nusxasi o'rniga bosma nusxasini o'qishni afzal ko'raman.
cards.uzDef: Kitob yoki hujjatning qog'ozdagi nusxasi.

cards.ex: I was so lost in the book that I didn't hear the phone ring.
cards.exUz: Men kitobga shunchalik berilib ketgandimki, telefon jiringlaganini eshitmadim.
cards.uzDef: Kitob o'qiyotganda atrofdagi narsalarni unutish.

cards.ex: To coin a phrase, it was a perfect storm of bad luck.
cards.exUz: Iborani ishlatganda, bu omadsizlikning mukammal bo'roni edi.
cards.uzDef: Yangi iborani yaratish yoki odatda ishlatiladigan iborani ishlatish.

cards.ex: Mark Twain was Samuel Clemens' pen name.
cards.exUz: Mark Tven Samuel Klemensning taxallusi edi.
cards.uzDef: Yozuvchi asl ismini yashirish uchun ishlatadigan xayoliy ism.

cards.ex: She wrote a tell-all book about her life with the celebrity.
cards.exUz: U mashhur odam bilan hayoti haqida hamma narsani aytadigan kitob yozdi.
cards.uzDef: Shaxsiy sirlarni ochadigan kitob.

cards.ex: It's time to turn the page and move on with our lives.
cards.exUz: Yangi sahifa ochish va hayotimizni davom ettirish vaqti keldi.
cards.uzDef: Hayotda yangi bosqich boshlash, o'tmishni unutish.
